name: The Tribe
source:
An 18+ Visual novel about man who wakes up naked on a riverbank and finds himself in a post-apocalyptic world where he's the only intelligent male among women. 

[From [url=https://foxyghost-art.itch.io/the-tribe]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部18岁以上视觉小说，讲述一名男子在河岸上赤身裸体醒来，发现自己身处一个后世界末日的世界，他是女性中唯一聪明的男性。

[来自[url=https://foxyghost-art.itch.io/the-tribe]Itch.io[/url]]
